body.statement: For the donor-only interval \(I_n^{\mathrm{out}}\), \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{P\in\mathcal P_n}P\{\theta_n\in I_n^{\mathrm{out}}\}\ge1-\alpha\), with no lower bound on either target loading. This strictly extends the loading-restricted Yan--Wainwright Gaussian interval by covering joint-zero and arbitrarily slow loading transitions in the same fixed-rank strong-donor model.
body.justification: Uniform coverage across the degenerate cone is the central inferential claim.
body.gap: Yan--Wainwright's main interval requires a loading-sensitive lower-bound condition, and their Appendix A does not construct an all-loading interval.
body.consumer: CAST users obtain valid missing-mean uncertainty even when fitted target factor loadings are nearly zero.
